text:
Before lunch, a short confusion led the lead dispatcher to ask questions about a companion animal booking, and I began this incident report to record the sequence clearly. A traveler had arrived at the Companion Animal Travel Desk with a crate that was briefly separated from the main check-in flow during a handover between teams. The traveler remained calm, and the pet was kept in a secure waiting area under steady supervision. I confirmed the paperwork already on file, checked the crate label against the manifest, and asked the baggage team to pause any further movement until the matter was settled. <<FACT F120>> The delay came from a mixed handoff, not from any safety concern, and the desk team kept the traveler informed in a warm and respectful manner throughout.

After the crate was located, I reviewed the condition of the item and confirmed that it remained intact and suitable for travel. <<FACT F112>> I then updated the travel notes, advised the traveler on the next steps, and reminded staff to verify crate routing at each transfer point. The lead dispatcher and I also spoke with the ground crew so the same confusion would not repeat on the next departure. The traveler accepted the explanation with courtesy, and service resumed without further issue. I will continue to monitor companion animal handoffs closely and will reinforce the check-in handover procedure at the start of the next shift.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
